_doc: How the VO takes are cut into beats and laid on the timeline. Seconds. Read by scripts/yt/vo-build.py.

_notes.narrator: Sarah (ElevenLabs GkP5h0UAcZQ2i4aDPipF, studio quality, full band), eleven_v4, stability 0.5, similarity 0.75, seed 42, mp3_44100_128, the paid account (Leo picked her 2026-11-11 over Megan, Katie and Mandi; Emily was rejected as robotic). No delivery tags: '[softly]' was performed as a whisper.
_notes.tempo: 1.0: her natural pace. No stretch (W44's stretch was the first robotic source).
_notes.tighten: Off: her longest pause between words is 0.51 s, so nothing needs cutting and no room tone switches on and off.
_notes.master: Gentle: -17 LUFS, 2:1 compressor with a 25 ms attack, -1 dBTP ceiling. The W44 defaults clamped a dynamic take hard enough to sound robotic (Leo, 2026-11-11).
_notes.extraAfter: Air only where the picture needs it. 4: the title and its whoosh. 10: the silence after 'Glomvo never finds out' (silence = done). 13: the turn from story to tutorial. 17: into the product (whoosh 2). 24: the padlocks and the fixed chime. 26: the dry drop-list beat lands. 32: the closing question hangs. 33: the end card holds for YouTube's end screen (W43, W41).
